quest_name: Sleepwalking Into A Nightmare (took Vaermina's bargain)
outcome: Accepted Vaermina's offer and killed Gretska in her sleep to become the Prince's champion
citation: B03 tier A terminal: s120 objective 'Accept or refuse Vaermina's offer' and journal 'Upon defeating the Lotus Vaermina reached out to me, offering me a boon for Gretska's life'; s210 'I need to kill Gretska to finish complete the deal'; s250 CompleteQuest 'I have completed Vaermina's offer, becoming her champion.' Tagged ritual_sacrifice because a life is offered to a Daedra for a boon, and kill_the_helpless because Gretska is asleep and cannot resist.
branch_note: Branch 1 of 2, mutually exclusive with s350. The mod's Nexus title advertises a new Daedric Prince; the records show it is VAERMINA, so the existing :vaermina namespace applies and no new slug is needed.

quest_name: Sleepwalking Into A Nightmare (refused the bargain)
outcome: Refused Vaermina's offer and woke Gretska from the nightmare instead
citation: B03 tier A: s300 'I have rejected Vaermina's offer, I should try to wake up Gretska', s320 'Gretska is now awake and has told me she will meet me back at the cabin with Ralforn'; s350 is the CompleteQuest terminal and carries no text of its own. RUNTIME-VERIFY: the terminal is tier C, so the branch is evidenced by s300/s320 rather than by s350 itself.
